decision: Final policy: event-driven auction/edge ADMM, pipelined majority task leases, robust local barrier, perfect bounded onboard proximity observation, local relay repair. Proximity radius=max(sensing radius,d_min+2*v_max+0.05); it is own sensor state, not radio-shared global information. Objective weights retained. Calibration uses seeds41-43; final unused holdout is3001-3020. All earlier1001/2001-series development/pilot data are excluded. Immutable broadcast snapshots preserve message values and are covered by a separate regression. Demo has180s cap; failure and healing sweeps have300s cap; default horizon600s. Final specification audit: crash timing covers [0,floor(0.6*T)); mission consensus uses relaxed Metropolis weights; all allocator variants expose assign(); latest ADMM residuals determine convergence; strict simultaneous-active recovery with vacuous zero delay. No physical objective weights changed. Illustration now replays a disclosed completed evaluation episode selected for a real non-vacuous recovery; only frame sampling differs. Demo horizon120s for runtime budget. No evaluation algorithm/physical parameters changed.
